question: Where can BiceLib add whether a division design can be paradropped to the division designer's terrainbonus tooltip, and what does the design list hold?

addresses.name: DivisionDesigner_BuildTooltip_TerrainCopy
addresses.comment: `call 0x401BD0` (E8 F0 71 C1 FF) in CDivisionDesigner::BuildTooltip's terrainbonus arm: std::string::assignString(out@ECX, &designer->terrain_text (+0x1D4), 0, -1), the three arguments pushed at 0x7EA9CD..0x7EA9D8. The designer is in [ebp-0x14] (stored from ECX at 0x7EA957) and `out` in EBX throughout the arm; the next instruction jumps to the epilogue, which sets EAX from EBX itself (0x7EC523). BiceLib's Hooks/Tooltips/ParadropLine replaces this call to put the paradrop line in front of the copied text. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-buildertooltips.md, sections 2 and 6.
addresses.evidence: disasm.py 0x7EA930: the arm is push -1 / push eax(0) / mov eax,[ebp-0x14] / add eax,0x1D4 / push eax / mov ecx,ebx / call 0x401BD0 / jmp 0x7EC51E, and 0x401BD0 is the record's std::string::assignString (rva 0x1BD0, confirmed). Shown wrong if the five bytes at 0x7EA9DB do not resolve to 0x401BD0, which Hooks::isCallTo checks before BiceLib writes anything.

struct_fields.name: design
struct_fields.comment: the brigades of the division being designed, each node's data a CSubUnitDefinition*, kept in priority order; the count is at +0x1BC
struct_fields.revises: the type was a bare CList and the comment said only 'unit types'
struct_fields.evidence: UpdateDesign's brigade loop (0x7E65A0..0x7E65B7) takes [node+0] and reads +0x1B4 off it - CSubUnitDefinition's combined arms group - with next at [node+8]; AddBrigade (0x7EA880) inserts its argument through CPrioComparator, which reads priority (+0x194) off the same pointer. Shown wrong if a node's data were a type index or a CRegiment: neither has the combined arms group at +0x1B4.
